name: Stability Ball Lat Stretch
steps: Kneel facing the ball and rest the edge of one hand on top with your thumb pointing up.
Keep your opposite hand resting lightly on your hip or the floor for balance.
Roll the ball forward and sit your hips toward your heels until you feel a stretch along the side of your back.
Hold the stretch steadily with deep breaths on one side, then roll the ball back in and switch arms.
tips: Keep your thumb pointed toward the ceiling to open the shoulder comfortably.
Keep your chest facing the floor so the stretch stays on the reaching side.
